Design.evidence_source: [page/10/Text/1] Experimental subjects played the game only once in a between-subject design and in groups of three.

country.evidence_source: [page/10/Text/4] The experiment was conducted using z-Tree (Fischbacher, 2007) at the TU-WZB lab in Berlin.

info_cost.evidence_source: [page/9/Text/5] In the second stage of the hidden information treatment, the third party does not observe the choice of the dictator, but can reveal it at no cost.

Sample.evidence_source: The provided N values (148 total, 60 in baseline, 88 in hidden information) refer to 'third-party decisions', not the dictator's decisions. The meta-analysis fields N_Self_CI_*, N_Altr_CI_*, N_Tot_CI_* are for the dictator's choices. The number of dictators in each condition is not reported in this section.

N_Self_CI_Tmt.evidence_source: The number of selfish choices made by dictators in the hidden information treatment is not reported in this section. The N values provided refer to 'third-party decisions'.

N_Self_CI_Ctr.evidence_source: The number of selfish choices made by dictators in the baseline treatment is not reported in this section. The N values provided refer to 'third-party decisions'.

N_Altr_CI_Ctr.evidence_source: The number of altruistic choices made by dictators in the baseline treatment is not reported in this section. The N values provided refer to 'third-party decisions'.

N_Tot_CI_Tmt.evidence_source: The total number of dictators in the hidden information treatment is not reported in this section. The N values provided (88) refer to 'third-party decisions'.

N_Tot_CI_Ctr.evidence_source: The total number of dictators in the baseline treatment is not reported in this section. The N values provided (60) refer to 'third-party decisions'.
